notes: §2002:14.8.35.3 GR3: a non-integer amount (GR3a) and an incremented or decremented occurrence number that is not a valid subscript for the table (GR3b) each set EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT, make the SET unsuccessful and leave the receiving index-name unchanged. GR3a is CobolIndex.TryAmount (SetAmountRule.IndexBy); GR3b is CobolIndex.AugmentWithinTable, emitted by SetEmitter.EmitSetUpDown before DialectBehavior.SetIndexOutsideTableStored, per receiver; PERFORM VARYING and SEARCH keep CobolIndex.Augment (the 2002 text gives them no such rule). With checking not enabled the GR3b outcome is implementor-defined and the result is stored (D-SET-INDEX-UNCHECKED). kb/Work PB5674.
